license_required.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in or conduct, directly or indirectly, or to advertise or represent to the public as engaging in or conducting the business or acting in the capacity of a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson within this state without a license as a broker or salesperson or otherwise complying with this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of realty regulation provided for in 2-15-1757.

name.quote: "Board" means the board of realty regulation provided for in 2-15-1757.

type.quote: "Board" means the board of realty regulation provided for in 2-15-1757.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industry provided for in Title 2, chapter 15, part 17.

age_minimum.quote: must be at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Licenses may be granted only to individuals considered by the board to be of good repute and competent to transact the business of a broker or a salesperson in a manner that safeguards the interests of the public.

degree_required.value: Graduated from an accredited high school or completed an equivalent education; plus 60 classroom or equivalent hours in board-approved broker course (in addition to salesperson hours)
degree_required.quote: must have graduated from an accredited high school or completed an equivalent education as determined by the board

degree_level.quote: must have graduated from an accredited high school or completed an equivalent education as determined by the board

school_approval_basis.quote: in a course of study approved by the board and taught by instructors approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: shall furnish written evidence that the applicant has completed 60 classroom or equivalent hours, in addition to those required to secure a salesperson's license, in a course of study approved by the board

required.quote: must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of 2 years or have had experience or special education equivalent to that which a licensed real estate salesperson ordinarily would receive during this 2-year period as determined by the board

experience_source.quote: must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of 2 years or have had experience or special education equivalent to that which a licensed real estate salesperson ordinarily would receive during this 2-year period as determined by the board

duration.quote: must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of 2 years

kind.quote: actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of 2 years

exams.name: Broker's License Examination
exams.notes: Must be more exacting, more stringent than the salesperson examination. Applicant must satisfactorily pass an examination dealing with the material taught in each course of the 60-hour broker course.
exams.quote: The examination for a broker's license must be of a more exacting nature and scope and more stringent than the examination for a salesperson's license.

required.quote: the board may not require examinations of licensees

available.quote: a licensed broker may pay a commission to a licensed broker of another state or jurisdiction if the nonresident broker has not conducted and does not conduct in this state a service for which a fee, compensation, or commission is paid.

requirements.value: A nonresident licensee must file an irrevocable written consent that legal actions may be commenced against them in an appropriate Montana county, with service of summons through the department.
requirements.quote: A nonresident licensee shall file an irrevocable written consent that legal actions arising out of a commenced or completed transaction may be commenced against the nonresident licensee in a county of this state

exists.quote: "Board" means the board of realty regulation provided for in 2-15-1757.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in or conduct, directly or indirectly, or to advertise or represent to the public as engaging in or conducting the business or acting in the capacity of a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson within this state without a license as a broker or salesperson or otherwise complying with this chapter.

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in or conduct, directly or indirectly, or to advertise or represent to the public as engaging in or conducting the business or acting in the capacity of a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson within this state without a license as a broker or salesperson

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in or conduct, directly or indirectly, or to advertise or represent to the public as engaging in or conducting the business or acting in the capacity of a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson within this state without a license as a broker or salesperson or otherwise complying with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misleading, untruthful, or inaccurate advertising that misrepresents property, terms, values, policies, or services in any material way.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally misleading, untruthful, or inaccurate advertising, whether printed or by radio, display, or other nature, if the advertising in any material particular or in any material way misrepresents any property, terms, values, policies, or services of the business conducted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false promises likely to influence, persuade, or induce a party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through agents, salespersons, or advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through agents or salespersons or any medium of advertising or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the term 'realtor' without authorization or using a trade name or insignia of a real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of the term "realtor" by a person not authorized to do so or using another trade name or insignia of membership in a real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for or remit money belonging to others that came into the licensee's possession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to account for or to remit money coming into the licensee's possession when the money belongs to others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, giving, or charging an undisclosed commission, rebate, or profit on expenditures made for a principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting, giving, or charging an undisclosed commission, rebate, or profit on expenditures made for a principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a dual capacity as broker and undisclosed principal in a transaction, including failing to disclose dual capacity in advertisements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting in a dual capacity of broker and undisclosed principal in a transaction, including failing to disclose in advertisements for real property the person's dual capacity as broker and principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing, authorizing, or permitting a person to guarantee future profits from resale of real property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: guaranteeing, authorizing, or permitting a person to guarantee future profits that may result from the resale of real property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering real property for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or on unauthorized terms.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering real property for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or the owner's authorized agent or on terms other than those authorized by the owner or the owner's authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing a party to break a sale or lease contract in order to substitute a new contract with another principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: inducing a party to a contract of sale or lease to break the contract for the purpose of substituting a new contract with another principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting compensation for appraising real property contingent on a predetermined value, or issuing an appraisal on property with an undisclosed interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting employment or compensation for appraising real property contingent on the reporting of a predetermined value or issuing an appraisal report on real property in which the broker or salesperson has an undisclosed interest

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negotiating directly with a seller or buyer known to have an exclusive written listing agreement or buyer broker agreement with another broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: negotiating a sale, exchange, or lease of real property directly with a seller or buyer if the broker or salesperson knows that the seller or buyer has a written, outstanding listing agreement or buyer broker agreement in connection with the property granting an exclusive agency to another broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, selling, or offering real property by conducting lotteries to influence purchasers.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: soliciting, selling, or offering for sale real property by conducting lotteries for the purpose of influencing a purchaser or prospective purchaser of real property

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker other than the employer without express knowledge or consent of the employer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as a salesperson, representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker other than the employer without the express knowledge or consent of the employer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing voluntarily to furnish a copy of a written instrument to a party executing it at the time of execution.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing voluntarily to furnish a copy of a written instrument to a party executing it at the time of its execution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unless exempted, paying a commission in connection with a real estate transaction to a person not licensed as a real estate broker or salesperson.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unless exempted, paying a commission in connection with a real estate sale or transaction to a person who is not licensed as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally violating a rule adopted by the board in the interests of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally violating a rule adopted by the board in the interests of the public and in conformity with this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson's failure to promptly place deposit money or other trust money in the custody of the supervising broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing, if a salesperson, to place, as soon after receipt as is practicably possible, in the custody of the salesperson's supervising broker, deposit money or other money entrusted to the salesperson in that capacity by a person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrating unworthiness or incompetency to act as a broker or salesperson.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: demonstrating unworthiness or incompetency to act as a broker or a salesperson

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet property management requirements under 37-56-105 through 37-56-107 or board rules while managing properties for owners.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to meet the requirements of 37-56-105 through 37-56-107 or the rules adopted by the board governing property management while managing properties for owners

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to all customers and clients the licensee's contractual relationship while managing properties for owners.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to disclose to all customers and clients, including owners and tenants, the licensee's contractual relationship while managing properties for owners

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain continuous professional liability insurance coverage that meets the statutory requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to maintain continuous professional liability insurance coverage that meets the requirements of 37-51-325

disciplinary_grounds.description: Openly advertising property belonging to others without a valid signed listing agreement from the owner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for a broker or salesperson to openly advertise property belonging to others, whether by means of printed material, radio, television, or display or by other means, unless the broker or salesperson has a signed listing agreement from the owner of the property.

insurance_required.quote: A real estate broker or salesperson with an active real estate license under this chapter must maintain continuous professional liability insurance coverage that meets the requirements of this section during the period of licensure.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A licensed broker shall maintain a designated physical address where the original license or a copy of the current license of the broker must be prominently displayed.

definition_quote.value: "Broker" includes an individual who: (a) for another or for valuable consideration or who with the intent or expectation of receiving valuable consideration negotiates or attempts to negotiate the listing, sale, purchase, rental, exchange, or lease of real estate or of the improvements on real estate or collects rents or attempts to collect rents...
definition_quote.quote: "Broker" includes an individual who: (a) for another or for valuable consideration or who with the intent or expectation of receiving valuable consideration negotiates or attempts to negotiate the listing, sale, purchase, rental, exchange, or lease of real estate or of the improvements on real estate or collects rents or attempts to collect rents

value: negotiating or attempting to negotiate the listing, sale, purchase, rental, exchange, or lease of real estate
conducting sale, leasing, subleasing, or other disposition of real estate for consideration
charging an advance fee or contracting for collection of a fee for promoting sale, lease, or disposition of real estate
advertising, sale, lease, or other real estate information available by public display
aiding any person in locating or obtaining real estate for purchase or lease for a fee
receiving a fee for referring prospective buyers or sellers to a licensed broker or salesperson
performing asset management services for real property in conjunction with marketing or transfer
methods_authorized.quote: for another or for valuable consideration or who with the intent or expectation of receiving valuable consideration negotiates or attempts to negotiate the listing, sale, purchase, rental, exchange, or lease of real estate or of the improvements on real estate or collects rents or attempts to collect rents

license_tiers.quote: "Supervising broker endorsement" means an endorsement to a broker's license that is required of any licensed broker who supervises licensed salespersons performing real estate activity.

broker_of_record_required.quote: A corporation or a partnership may act as a licensee if every corporate officer and every partner performing the functions of a licensee is licensed under this chapter.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of 2 years or have had experience or special education equivalent to that which a licensed real estate salesperson ordinarily would receive during this 2-year period as determined by the board

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: shall furnish written evidence that the applicant has completed 60 classroom or equivalent hours, in addition to those required to secure a salesperson's license, in a course of study approved by the board

required_instruction_topics.quote: The course of study must include the subjects of real estate principles, real estate law, real estate finance, and related topics.

agency_relationship_types.quote: "Dual agent" means a broker or salesperson who...acts as the agent of both the buyer and seller with written authorization

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A BROKER OR A SALESPERSON MAY NOT ACT AS A DUAL AGENT WITHOUT THE SIGNED, WRITTEN CONSENT OF BOTH THE SELLER AND THE BUYER

designated_agency_permitted.quote: "In-house buyer agent designate" means a broker or salesperson employed by or associated as an independent contractor with a broker and designated by the broker as the exclusive agent for a buyer for a designated transaction

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Statutory broker" means a broker or salesperson who assists one or more parties to a real estate transaction without acting as an agent or representative of any party to the real estate transaction.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A broker or salesperson shall disclose the existence and nature of relevant agency or other relationships to the parties to a real estate transaction as provided in this section.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A licensed broker or salesperson must obtain an appropriate written buyer broker agreement or written listing agreement prior to performing the acts of a buyer agent or a seller agent.

fixed_office_required.quote: A licensed broker shall maintain a designated physical address where the original license or a copy of the current license of the broker must be prominently displayed.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: The application must be accompanied by the recommendation of a licensed broker with a supervising broker endorsement by whom the applicant will be employed or placed under contract, certifying that the applicant is of good repute and that the broker will actively supervise and train the applicant during the period the requested license remains in effect.

value: owner or lessor performing acts with reference to their own property or auctioneer employed by owner/lessor
person acting as attorney-in-fact under special or general power of attorney (unless doing so regularly for a fee to avoid licensing)
attorney at law in performance of duties
person appointed by court for evaluating or appraising estate in a probate matter
receiver, trustee in bankruptcy, administrator or executor, person selling under court order, trustee under trust agreement/deed of trust/will, or auctioneer employed by same
public officials in the conduct of their official duties
person/partnership/association/corporation performing acts with respect to prospecting, leasing, drilling, or operating land for hydrocarbons and hard minerals
right-of-way transfers for roads, utilities, and other public purposes (not including conservation easements or easements for recreational purposes)
newspaper or other publication of general circulation
radio or television station in normal course of business
digital media platforms hosting real estate advertisements without performing licensable services
license_exemptions.quote: The licensing provisions of this chapter do not: (a) apply to any person who, as owner or lessor, performs any acts listed in subsection (1) with reference to property owned or leased by the person
